outcome: Duration of active phase of labor
cohort: 19,524 women who delivered at Stavanger University Hospital in Norway, excluding those with previous cesarean section, multiple pregnancy, breech or transverse lie, preterm labor or prelabor cesarean section
finding: The active phase of labor was longer in induced labors than in spontaneous labors in nulliparous women, while in parous women the difference was small and likely not clinically significant.
mod_finding: Induced labors had a longer active phase of labor compared to spontaneous labors in nulliparous women.
